svg.text: STEPPER_BUZZ — which motor, which corner, which way

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One motor per command. It moves 1 mm positive, pauses, returns, ten times. Watch the machine, not the console.

svg.text: A and B are NOT direction-checked by buzzing

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on CoreXY a single motor's rotation is not a meaningful check by eye

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What matters at STEPPER_BUZZ is only that the right motor

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: answers and moves cleanly. Direction is settled at homing: G28

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: X must travel the toolhead to the RIGHT, G28 Y to the BACK.

svg.text: The extruder buzzes too — STEPPER_BUZZ STEPPER=extruder with no filament — but its direction is not tested until the first extrude. Never move a stepper connector with power on.
